meta.title: Private search for your agent
meta.description: An MCP server that gives your agent the whole web through SearXNG: metasearch, news, images, videos, autocomplete and clean page extraction. MIT, no API keys, self-hostable.

hero.lead: One MCP connection gives an agent metasearch, news, images, videos, autocomplete and clean page extraction — through a SearXNG instance you run. No search API keys, no per-query invoice, no vendor reading the query log.

demo.title: Ask the instance that powers the agent.
demo.lead: This box issues the same request the server issues —
demo.leadAfter: against the instance this deployment is configured with — then renders the answer with the MCP's own formatter, vendored verbatim. Switch to
demo.leadTail: for the exact text the model receives.
demo.note: The instance is configured on the server and never leaves it: no address reaches the browser bundle, the page, or an error message. Public instances throttle the JSON API, so a
demo.noteAfter: here means the instance answered — not that the demo broke.

output.title: Text, not JSON. Sized for a context window.
output.lead: A tool result is a compact Markdown block: rank, title, URL, a 300-character snippet, then provenance. Engines that failed are named rather than silently dropped, so the model knows what it did not see.
output.lead2: Every field above survives the trip through
output.lead2After: , a pure function with its own tests — the same code this page runs. Nothing is summarised by an LLM on the way out, so a quote you get back is a quote.

tools.title: Seven tools. One connection.
tools.lead: Each tool validates its arguments with zod before a request leaves the process, and answers with the contract above. Domain filters run locally, after the instance answers, so
tools.leadTail: never hide the rest of the page from you.

items.search: Metasearch across the engines your instance has enabled, ranked and deduplicated.
items.news: The same contract scoped to news, adding publication dates when the engine reports them.
items.images: Image results with both the full-size URL and a thumbnail the agent can weigh.
items.videos: Video results with thumbnails and the page the video came from.
items.autocomplete: Instance autocomplete, for widening a query the engines answered thinly.
items.config: The instance itself: URL, locale, categories and every enabled engine grouped by category. Call it when an engine name is rejected.
items.extract: Fetches a page and returns readable article text — Readability plus Turndown, site chrome stripped before it reaches the model.

install.title: Add it in one line.
install.leadTail: ; the demo above talks to whichever instance this deployment set on the server, so its URL never appears in the page.

env.url: Base URL of your instance. Defaults to probing healthy instances from searx.space; must serve /search with format=json enabled.
env.timeout: Per-request deadline. Defaults to 20000 — raise it on a slow or self-hosted instance.
env.browser: Optional CDP endpoint (Chrome or Obscura) for extraction on pages that need JavaScript. Also read as SEARXNG_OBSCURA_URL.

skill.title: Teach the agent the surface.
skill.lead: The MCP gives an agent seven tools; the skill tells it which one to reach for, in what order, and what a
skill.leadMid: note in the output means. One command installs it for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor and omp — no clone, no config file.
skill.agents: claude code · codex · opencode · cursor · omp
skill.note: Reads the repository directly: install the skill alone and skip the other twenty.
